summary: Haymaker Acquisition Corp V, a Cayman-domiciled blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting consummation of its $287.5M IPO on September 18, 2026, selling 28.75M units at $10.00, including full exercise of a 3.75M-unit over-allotment. Concurrently, the sponsor bought 4.0M private placement warrants and underwriters Cantor Fitzgerald, William Blair and Roth Capital bought 1.333M, each at $1.50, raising $8M. Proceeds, including $12.25M deferred underwriting discount, were placed in a Continental Stock Transfer trust. No business combination target, board recommendation or advisor was named; watch for a deal announcement, extension votes and redemption dynamics.
